description:
Get the results of a BigQuery SQL query job.

Use this tool ONLY when:
1. A previous `execute_sql` or `execute_sql_readonly` call returned `jobComplete: false` with a `jobId`
   (poll with this tool until `jobComplete: true`), OR
2. You need to paginate through additional rows using `pageToken` or `startIndex` for a previously completed job.

Do NOT call this tool if the query already returned `jobComplete: true` with all rows (no `pageToken`).

Supports pagination. Use `maxResults` to limit res

inputSchema.description: Request for getting query results of a job.

jobId.description: Required. Job ID of the query job.

location.description: Required. The geographic location of the job.

maxResults.description: Optional. Maximum number of results to read. Defaults to 3,000.

pageToken.description: Optional. Page token, returned by a previous call, to request the next page of results.

projectId.description: Required. Project ID of the query job.

startIndex.description: Optional. Zero-based index of the starting row.

timeoutMs.description: Optional. Specifies the maximum amount of time, in milliseconds, that the client is willing to wait for the query to complete.

name: google-bigquery__get_query_results
